headline: Quiet night; the 10:00 with Sam is the day's hinge — bring the signup number
briefScript:
Quiet night, nothing on fire. The ten o'clock with Sam is the one that matters today.

Sam asked on Tuesday how the onboarding test was holding up, so have the signup number ready before you walk in. Maya's pre-read for the two o'clock landed overnight with a first cut of the retention curve.

Overnight, Priya approved the pricing-page fix and asked one follow-up: should the same change go to the annual plan copy too? That's waiting on you, and a two-line answer unblocks her for the day.

My one recommendation: answer Priya before standup. It's a two-minute reply and it keeps her moving while you're in meetings. Let me know if you have any questions.
